description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for Hadoop file system operations within Apache Spark, including recursive listing of files and directories with support for parallel execution and filtering.

classes.name: HadoopFSUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions for Hadoop file system operations, including recursive listing, filtering, and parallel processing.

methods.name: parallelListLeafFiles
methods.description: Lists a collection of paths recursively, choosing strategy based on path count, intended to be called only on the driver.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files under a given path with filtering, callable on both driver and executors.

methods.name: parallelListLeafFilesInternal
methods.description: Internal method to perform parallel recursive listing of paths, with threshold-based short-circuiting.

methods.name: listLeafFiles
methods.description: Recursively lists a single filesystem path, optionally launching Spark jobs for parallelization.

methods.name: shouldFilterOutPathName
methods.description: Determines if a path name should be filtered out based on naming conventions.

methods.name: shouldFilterOutPath
methods.description: Recursively checks if a path should be filtered out based on specific patterns.
